block.create_henry.fluid_hatch.tooltip.b: _Empties_ your _held fluid container_ into the _tank_ it faces. _Sneak-click_ to _empty_ _everything_ except Hotbar items.
block.create_henry.fluid_hatch.tooltip.s: _Quickly empties_ your _fluid containers_ into nearby storage.
create_henry.ponder.bore_block.header: Mining through blocks with the Bore Block
create_henry.ponder.bore_block.text_1: The Bore Block destroys any block in its path when moved by a contraption
create_henry.ponder.bore_block.text_2: Blocks in its path are broken as the bore advances
create_henry.ponder.bore_block.text_3: Reversing the shaft lets the bore clear any blocks in its path on the return pass
create_henry.ponder.flywheel.text_1: The Powered Flywheel connects the Flywheel Engine to the kinetic network
create_henry.ponder.flywheel.text_2: It provides a moderate but reliable source of Rotational Force
create_henry.ponder.furnace_engine.heade: Generating Rotational Force with the Flywheel Engine
create_henry.ponder.furnace_engine.text_: The Flywheel Engine generates Rotational Force while its Blast Furnace is running
It provides a moderate but reliable source of Rotational Force
create_henry.ponder.golden_mixer.header: Processing Items with the Golden Mixer
create_henry.ponder.golden_mixer.text_1: The Golden Mixer is an upgraded Mechanical Mixer that operates 2.5x times faster, processing recipes much faster
create_henry.ponder.golden_mixer.text_2: It handles Shapeless Crafting and Mixing recipes, just like the Mechanical Mixer
create_henry.ponder.golden_mixer.text_4: Some recipes require the heat of a Blaze Burner placed below the Basin
create_henry.ponder.golden_mixer.text_5: The filter slot can be used to resolve conflicts when multiple recipes are compatible
create_henry.ponder.hydraulic_press.head: Bulk Processing Items with the Hydraulic Press
create_henry.ponder.hydraulic_press.text: The Hydraulic Press can process items provided beneath it
Items can be dropped or placed on a Depot under the Press
When items are provided on a belt...
The Press will hold and process them automatically
create_henry.ponder.industrial_brake.hea: Applying Stress Load with the Industrial Brake
create_henry.ponder.industrial_brake.tex: The Industrial Brake draws a flat amount of Stress from the network, regardless of RPM
Right-click the panel to set how many SU it draws (0 to 256)
Raising the draw increases the load on the network
create_henry.ponder.industrial_fan_direc: The Industrial Fan accepts rotational input from the back, like any kinetic block
As a cogwheel itself, it also accepts drive from a cogwheel meshing on its side
create_henry.ponder.industrial_fan_proce: Processing Items with the Industrial Fan
The Industrial Fan generates a longer airstream than a standard Encased Fan
Items caught in the area will be sanded
A Wither Rose withers items passing through the airstream
Items caught in the area will be withered
Powder Snow freezes items as they pass through
Items caught in the area will be frozen
A Seething Blaze Burner unlocks powerful heat processing
Items caught in the area will be processed by intense heat
A Dragon Head fills the stream with dragon's breath for End-related recipes
Items caught in the area will be infused with dragon's breath
Fan Processing can also be applied to Items on Depots and Belts
When passing through lava, the Air Flow becomes Heated
Items caught in the area will be smelted
A lit Campfire creates a Smoking zone for food-related recipes
Items caught in the area will be smoked
Air Flows passing through water create a Washing zone
Items caught in the area will be washed
New processing types are also added
Sand performs all Sand Paper Polishing recipes, and more
create_henry.ponder.inverse_box.header: Inverting rotation with the Inverse Box
create_henry.ponder.inverse_box.text_1: The Inverse Box relays rotation along a shaft
create_henry.ponder.inverse_box.text_2: The rotation on the other side is always inverted
create_henry.ponder.kinetic_motor.header: Generating Rotational Force using Kinetic Motors
create_henry.ponder.kinetic_motor.text_1: Kinetic motors are a compact and configurable source of Rotational Force
create_henry.ponder.kinetic_motor.text_2: The generated speed can be configured on its input panels
create_henry.ponder.multimeter.header: Reading Speed and Stress with the Multimeter
create_henry.ponder.multimeter.text_1: The Multimeter combines a Speedometer and Stressometer into one block, tracking both shaft Speed and network Stress load simultaneously
create_henry.ponder.multimeter.text_2: Wearing Engineers' Goggles provides exact RPM and SU readouts from the gauge
create_henry.ponder.redstone_divider.hea: Dividing rotational speed with the Redstone Divider
create_henry.ponder.redstone_divider.tex: The Redstone Divider relays rotation like a normal shaft when unpowered
The Analog Lever controls the signal strength sent to the divider
A Redstone signal reduces the output speed
Stronger signals divide the speed further
At full signal strength, the output is brought to a complete stop
create_henry.ponder.roll_table.header: Transporting Items with the Roll Table
create_henry.ponder.roll_table.text_1: The Roll Table accepts items and rolls them across its surface to the opposite side
create_henry.ponder.roll_table.text_2: Items exit on the opposite side and fall if nothing is there to receive them
create_henry.ponder.roll_table.text_3: Belts on any side can deliver items to the Roll Table and collect its output on the other side
create_henry.ponder.shared.behaviour_mod: This behaviour can be modified using the value panel
create_henry.ponder.shared.movement_anch: With the help of Super Glue, larger structures can be moved.
create_henry.ponder.shared.storage_on_co: Inventories attached to the Contraption will pick up their drops automatically
create_henry.ponder.smart_hopper.header: Filtering Items with the Smart Hopper
create_henry.ponder.smart_hopper.text_1: The Smart Hopper pulls items from above
create_henry.ponder.smart_hopper.text_2: And pushes them in the direction its spout faces
create_henry.ponder.smart_hopper.text_3: Items in the filter slot specify what to extract and transfer
create_henry.ponder.smart_hopper.text_4: Matching items are transferred to the output
create_henry.ponder.smart_hopper.text_5: Non-matching items are left on top
create_henry.ponder.smart_hopper.text_6: Use the value panel to specify the transferred stack size
create_henry.ponder.smart_hopper.text_7: A Redstone signal disables the Smart Hopper
create_henry.ponder.tag.create_henry.des: Blocks added by the Create: Henry Lookings mod
create_henry.recipe.fan_seething.fan: Fan behind Super Heated Blaze Burner
